page0.text:
"Hup...!"
Just by instinct, I leap without looking.
I use Tohsaka's blind spot, the corner of the hallway as a shield, and jump sideways with all my might...!

page1.text:
Just barely, I slide into the hallway.
"Damn...!"
I hear her click her tongue irritatingly and something heavy hit the wall.
"Wait... What did she...!?"
I look behind me as I stand up.

page2.text:
The wall...
The wall that was behind me has something sizzling and smoking coming out of it.
And...
To be more specific, there are three fist-sized burn marks on the wall.

page3.text:
...
A projectile weapon... No, that is a curse that infects the target with illness.

page4.text:
I think the Gandr Shot that Tohsaka was talking about is from Northern European Rune magecraft. It's an indirect curse that can worsen the condition of a person by pointing at them.
But that should just be a curse that makes a person feel sick. It shouldn't be anything like physically striking something with a projectile.

page5.text:
And yet...Tohsaka's Gandr is so packed full of magical energy, it manifests like a bullet.
Like, it doesn't just appear similar to a bullet, but strikes like one too...!

page6.text:
Wow, as expected of Tohsaka.
There's usually a limit to how much force one can use to turn a slow curse into an immediate curse.

page7.text:
"Man, is she trying to kill me...!?"
"That's what I've been telling you!"
Her descending footsteps echo behind me.

page8.text:
"Ungh...!"
I regain my balance and take off at full speed.
No time. I have no time. I have to get out of here!

page9.text:
"The hallway. No, the hallway is stupid...!"
Can't do that. There's no cover.
Tohsaka's weapon is a projectile, so if I just run down the hallway, it'll just funnel the shots right into my back.

page10.text:
"Don't move...!"
Tohsaka leaps out from around the corner.
And just in time, a hair ahead of her...
I dive into the classroom beside me, room 2-F.

page11.text:
Gandr shots fill the hall.
It seems like Tohsaka fired the moment she cleared the staircase.

page12.text:
"What a joke, I can't fight something like that...! How can she tell me to fight!? I'm no match for her...!"
I urgently look around the classroom.
I need protection.
Is there some shield or clothes or bulletproof vest that would protect me even if I got shot...!?

page13.text:
"Crap, she's here...!"
Tohsaka's footsteps stop at the entrance of the classroom.
...I'm sure she saw me run in here.
Maybe she's wary of a counterattack so she froze just outside...

page14.text:
"Yeah right, idiot...!"
I run.
As I dart from one side of the classroom to the other, sprinting towards the exit up front...
A hail of bullets mercilessly fly through the air!

page15.text:
Oh god, she's shooting like crazy...!
The bullets penetrate the wall, shooting radially inside the classroom.

page16.text:
"Ugh...! One must've grazed my back!"
If I hesitated for a moment longer I'd have been hit center mass.

page17.text:
"Ungh!? No way, how are you still standing!?"
Rin Tohsaka springs into the classroom.
There are about four meters between us, as we stand at both entrances in the front and the back of the classroom. We glare at each other again... But I have to...!

page18.text:
I jump out to the hallway.
Escaping through the classroom is not an option.
At this point, I can only sprint towards the stairs!

page19.text:
"Ngh!"
Man, she really is merciless!
I think it scraped my temple just now! My side...! My side too!

page20.text:
"Ow, owwww! Damn, are you serious!? That's going to screw me right over if I get hit by that!"
"That's the point, you jackass!
If you don't want to get hurt, stop and I'll make it nice and quick!"

page21.text:
The bullets fly through the air.
And just why does it sound even more like actual bullets now!?

page22.text:
"Hold on, aren't you shooting Gandr!?
That sounds more like a freaking gun that'll kill me!"

page23.text:
"Shut up! Then don't run away! It's your fault I have to focus my fire! A moving target's harder!"
The gunshots echo even louder.
But in the nick of time...
I barely make it to the stairs by the 2-A classroom.

page24.text:
"Ha... Haah, haah, ha...!"
I run down the stairs.
Making it this far brings me closer to victory.
I reach the landing to the second story.
If I can get to the first floor, even Tohsaka won't go through the trouble to follow me...

page25.text:
I'm speechless.
Tohsaka took a shortcut by jumping over the stairway handrail.

page26.text:
By which I mean...
In order to get down to the first floor from these stairs, I now have Tohsaka barring the way in front of me. She smiles confidently.

page27.text:
"...I'm surprised. You're pretty agile. Even though you were saying you had some extra weight before."
...
Ah.
Yeah, I think I can see a vein pop on her forehead.

page28.text:
It's scary how I'm getting used to this.
The instant I realize it's coming, my legs send me jumping sideways as I hear the sound of bullets hitting the wall.

page29.text:
I flee in the opposite direction.
The good news is I'm down to the second floor hallway.
If I'm able to make good time, I can get to the first floor, where I'm sure even Tohsaka won't—

page30.text:
"Really, still? You're persistent, Tohsaka! Give it up already!"
"You also don't know when to give up...! I won't kill you, so give it up already...!"

page31.text:
I don't know if it's because she's seriously serious, or because she's just lost it from the goose chase I've given her...
But if Tohsaka's shots get any louder, someone's gonna call the cops on us for sure.
"Eek...!
I really gotta stop worrying about stuff like that...!"
With the power increase comes bigger bullets, too.
The near misses from this so-called curse felt hot before, but now they're torching everything in their path.

page32.text:
"Ow...!"
One Gandr just faintly scrapes my leg.
My speed drops immediately.
The instant I know she'll catch up to me before I make it to the stairs, I fling myself into the nearest classroom.

page33.text:
"Ungh..."
Inside, I make for a window.
So now...
I should be able to manage a jump out from this second story window.
I'll get shot if I go back into the hall, so this looks like the better choice.

page34.text:
"...Das Schließung (Prepare). Vogelkäfig, Echo (Soundproof, Termination)."
I hear Tohsaka's voice in the hallway.
Something like a thin membrane envelops the classroom.

page35.text:
"...A Bounded Field...?"
The moment I realize that it is a Bounded Field with some sort of soundproofing effect, I know exactly what she's going to do.

page36.text:
"Agh!!!"
I dive toward the wall by the windows.

page37.text: I can feel a strong magecraft being activated.

page38.text: Quickly, I upend a desk and crouch behind it.

page39.text: This isn't like the Gandr she's fired until now.

page40.text: I close my eyes and place my hand on the underside of the desk.

page41.text:
She's making an incantation.
Even though she has the help from her Magic Crest, Tohsaka is chanting a spell.

page42.text:
Will I make it? No, I have to make it.
I skip all stages of the process of creating a second set of nerves in my spine, and pour as much magical energy as possible into the desk...!

page45.text:
Light and sound explode.
It's an ordinary day after school, and this mundane, everyday classroom is suddenly a dance floor.

page46.text:
The desks dance.
The magical energy being released here is nothing like the pistol fire from before.
This is more like a machine gun in terms of coverage and speed.

page47.text:
I don't know exactly what effect this curse filled with magical energy has, but it's strong enough to be visible to the human eye.
As it has mass, it destroys everything it touches.
The desks that are lined up in the classroom go wild like a person set ablaze.
My eardrums are already screwed from the sounds of the dancing desks and the echoing bullets.

page48.text:
A battlefield might actually be a more apt description.
Despite that, there is not a single crack in the windows.
It must be the power of the Bounded Field that Tohsaka put up.
Right now, this classroom is an enclosed space.
Even if one can enter, they can't leave.

page49.text:
The dozens of bullets fired in here are no exception, and even these loud sounds don't escape this room.
...Damn.
Even when she looks like she's going apeshit, Tohsaka is a calculating mage through and through!

page50.text:
"Ungh...!"
I put as much energy as I can produce into my makeshift shield.
The desk is under the effects of Strengthening—the one kind of magecraft I'm any good at—giving me a defense against this magical rain.

page51.text:
"Guh...!"
But, that's only for a brief moment.
My Strengthening can only endure three seconds from the rain of bullets.
As a result, I redo the spell the instant that it wears off and have to repeat this for as long as my magical energy lasts, but...

page53.text:
The rain does not stop.
...Maybe Tohsaka knows what's going on in this classroom.
She might still be attacking since she knows that I'm still blocking her attacks like this.
In that case, this rain would stop when...

page54.text:
"...When my magical energy runs out, huh...?"
While focusing my energy on the desk, I slump my shoulders.
...Then let's compare our stamina.
We'll just have to see who concedes first!

page55.text:
"...Ugh, even so..."
It's like the match has already been decided.
I feel like I got KO'd fifteen seconds into the first round.
I'm not wounded and I've still got stamina to spare. But I'm stuck and can't do anything if I run out of magical energy.

page56.text:
"...And, man."
I peek from behind the desk.
The smoke filling the classroom makes everything hazy.
I hear a clanging sound.
My hand bumps into some kind of rod on the floor.
"A chair leg, huh... She really destroyed this place."
Well, I guess it can be used as a makeshift weapon.
The rod is about twenty centimeters long. I take hold and pour what remaining magical energy I can into it.
"...It worked. Guess I never miss when it's the real thing."

page57.text:
I try a practice swing with the Strengthened club.
...Well.
Things won't get better if I just sit here. I'll just be full of holes if she attacks again.
Maybe I used too much magical energy, as I can't even stand.

page58.text:
"Hrrk... Gah, kah..."
And I can't even breathe in this smoke.

page59.text:
"Smoking me out, huh? She's got it all planned out."
Tohsaka is experienced in fighting.
She'll just corner me if I stay here.
...I'm sure she's waiting for me in the hallway, but I can't escape from the window because of that weird Bounded Field.

page60.text:
...
I make up my mind and go to the hallway.
With the numbness of my feet still there, I push past the wreckage of desks, and I crawl forward into the white smoke before me.
Then beyond the scorched ruins...

page61.text:
"...Heh. You finally came out, Emiya."
Tohsaka is waiting for me, with her shoulders heaving.

page62.text:
"..."
I glare at her and manage to pull myself up.
Guess the numbness is temporary and I can move my legs if I really try.

page63.text:
Not that mobility will be enough.
Tohsaka is only winded from all the running around. She's got plenty of magical energy to spare.
I've got no magical energy left. She's just a bit low on stamina.
The moment we resume this battle, I'm gonna be shot down for sure.

page64.text:
"It's over. Come on, throw away that silly weapon. You don't have a chance at winning."
Rin Tohsaka gloats over her victory.

page65.text:
"..."
That pisses me off.
Honestly, I know I have no chance in hell, but I can't help but feel insulted.

page66.text:
"...Well, you never know. And I don't think you have any room to say that while huffing and puffing like an asthmatic, stupid."
I point the leg of the chair at Tohsaka as a sign that I'm gonna go down swinging.

page67.text:
"...Mm, I see.
Fine, I was going to be nice if you were going to give up, but it seems like that's casting pearls before swine. So let me apologize in advance, Emiya."
She grins.
I wish she wouldn't make such an ominous smile.

page68.text: "Huh? Apologize for what? Even if you apologize now, I'm not going to forgive you for this."

page69.text:
"I'm apologizing for what's about to happen, Emiya.
I can't hold back if you resist, right? If I accidentally kill you, it'll be too late to offer any apologies then, you know."

page70.text:
"Ungh...!"
Shit, she's serious...!
Er, not that she hasn't been serious up to now, but this seems like she's had her last breaker flipped. I now realize I'm truly just a sitting duck, and earlier she was just getting her ducks in a row...

page71.text:
"Oh, you finally understand? Good, if you said something brainless I'd have had to really do something about it."
"Ugh... What do you mean by 'something'?"

page72.text:
...
She glares at me.
...Er, okay.
Something brainless like that, yeah, I got it.

page73.text:
"...This is your final warning.
Throw away that silly weapon of yours and give me your Command Spells. Worst case scenario, it'll rip off your arm's nerves, but that's better than losing your life, right?"

page74.text:
...
Give up my Command Spells?
Those aren't something I can afford to give, and most of all...

page75.text:
"...No. I can't do that."
"...I see. Let me ask: Why?"

page76.text:
"If I were to give you my Command Spells, that'd be the same as betraying Saber."
"...All right. I'll give you three seconds. It's your life, so you decide."

page77.text:
Tohsaka raises her left arm.
I bet she'll fire a Gandr the moment I refuse.
I...
